### SAS Global Forum 2016 - Student Symposium

With Samuel Perreault, I won the Student Symposium at SAS Global Forum 2016 in Las Vegas for a large-scale data analysis project. The Faculty of Science and Engineering article published April 27, 2016 links to a report and an interview.
→ [Article and resources](https://www.fsg.ulaval.ca/faculte/actualites/mm-nicosia-et-perreault-grands-vainqueurs-du-symposium-etudiant-du-sas-global-forum-2016-1812)

## Competitions

- SAS Global Forum - Student Symposium (2016). Competition won with Samuel Perreault. [Université Laval article in French](https://www.fsg.ulaval.ca/faculte/actualites/mm-nicosia-et-perreault-grands-vainqueurs-du-symposium-etudiant-du-sas-global-forum-2016-1812).

- ActuLab (2015) - *"Can you predict my golf score?"*. Competition won with Sylvain Demars. Our method predicts a final round score from the holes already played. [Original report in French: Méthode du plus proche voisinage (May 30, 2015, PDF)](../assets/archives/2015-demars-nicosia-golf.pdf).

## Early work and tools (2015-2016) {#early-work}

These projects document my early R development and science communication activities.

- 2015\. [GeneralOaxaca](packages.qmd#software-generaloaxaca), an R package for Blinder-Oaxaca decomposition of generalized linear models, published on CRAN.
- 2016\. [Corrected-Ngrams](https://github.com/aureliennicosia/Corrected-Ngrams), a Shiny application associated with the work presented at the SAS Global Forum Student Symposium. It explores word frequencies in Google Ngram while accounting for the growth of the scientific literature.
- 2016\. [Angular-Regression](https://github.com/aureliennicosia/Angular-Regression), a Shiny angular regression application with an example based on caribou movement.

The application links lead to historical code and its original instructions. Current software is presented in the [software catalogue](packages.qmd).
